item.review:
The change removes the empty-input guard, so `average([])` no longer returns its documented value of 0.

Review comment:

- [P1] Preserve the empty-list result — C:\project\average.mjs:3-3
  When `values` is empty, this now computes `0 / 0` and returns `NaN`, contradicting the function’s documented behavior that an empty list averages to 0. Callers relying on that documented result will receive a non-finite value instead.
